g.text: RELEASE TO SEND · SLIDE UP TO CANCEL

svg.text: Hold, speak, release. Time and place are attached
automatically, the voice is transcribed and
sorted, and the villager only confirms. No
signal? It waits on the phone.

g.text: SOLID = VERIFIED, COLOUR = LEVEL · DASHED = UNVERIFIED

svg.text: A solid glow is verified and its colour is the
level. A dashed ring is unverified, so it never
reads as Blue. Nearby reports merge into one

what the shelter holds — one screen.
